description: Which font is this? Reads the text in a picture (PNG, JPG, WebP, a screenshot or photo) or a page of a PDF, HWP, JTD or XDW, and ranks the fonts it looks like from ezpzfile.com's font finder (Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, Thai, Hindi, Vietnamese). Each match has its similarity, whether it is free, paid or bundled with the OS, its licence and, for free fonts, download links. The models come from ff.ezpzfile.com; the picture never leaves this computer.

page.description: Page to look at, for documents (default 1)

path.description: Absolute path of the picture or document

region.description: Look only inside this box, in pixels of the picture (for documents: of the page drawn at 150 dpi)

script.description: Force the script instead of guessing

text.description: What the text says, if the reading is wrong; letters in order

name: font_find
title: Find font
